Overview

Quetzaltenango is a city in QZ with a population of 250,000. Guatemala’s second city, a highland cultural center with stunning colonial architecture and indigenous traditions. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.0.
